title: LoRC: Detecting AI-Generated Images via Low-Rank Collapse in Semantic Residuals
summary: Modern generators faithfully model macroscopic semantics, producing synthetic images that appear highly realistic. Consequently, decisive forensic cues reside in subtle non-semantic visual discrepancies. To reveal these cues, we revisit AIGI detection from a geometric perspective and identify an architecture-agnostic signature. Specifically, modern generators exhibit low-rank collapse (\textit{i.e.}, rank degeneracy) in the semantic-residual orthogonal subspace while largely preserving the dominant semantic direction. This structural flattening consistently emerges during the final decoding stage, forming a shared bottleneck across diverse generator architectures. Motivated by this signature, we propose \textbf{LoRC}, a framework that decouples semantic dominance to capture the collapsed residual geometry induced by the generative decoding bottleneck. Our method improves accuracy by an average of 7.0\% across multiple benchmarks and achieves 97.0\% accuracy on 39 unseen generators. These results demonstrate strong cross-model generalization and robustness, making LoRC a reliable approach for AIGI detection in complex real-world environments.

AI.tldr: 本文从几何视角发现现代生成器在语义残差正交子空间中存在低秩坍缩（即秩退化），并基于此提出LoRC框架用于检测AI生成图像，平均准确率提升7.0%，在39个未见生成器上达到97.0%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有生成器生成的图像在宏观语义上高度逼真，但决定性的取证线索存在于细微的非语义视觉差异中，因此需要从非语义视角寻找通用且鲁棒的检测信号。
AI.method: 从几何角度分析生成器特征，识别出低秩坍缩（rank degeneracy）作为架构无关的签名；提出LoRC框架，通过解耦语义主导成分来捕捉由生成解码瓶颈导致的坍缩残差几何结构。
AI.result: 在多个基准上平均准确率提升7.0%，在39个未见生成器上达到97.0%的准确率，展现出强跨模型泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LoRC是一种可靠的AIGI检测方法，能够有效应对复杂真实环境下的AI生成图像检测需求。

title: Calibrating Criterion Revision in LLM Agents: Failure Modes and a Trace-Anchored Protocol
comment: 18 pages, 8 tables, 1 figure. CMB-0.1 is an instrument-calibration study; CMB-0.4 is a prospective protocol, not an empirical result
summary:
Language-model agents can improve after failure or carry text across episodes without revising what counts as success. We study the narrower attribution problem of criterion revision: when criterion K0 accepts an outcome violating a broader commitment B, what observations justify saying that the system formed and persistently used K1? We require five non-compensatory conditions: criterion-failure detection, a model-emitted proposal, new-episode transfer, intervention sensitivity on the claimed carrier, and preservation.
  We evaluate CMB-0.1 on twelve cross-domain cases and four arms: stateless inference, append-only history, model-generated but harness-committed state, and evaluator-written oracle state. Seven mechanism fixtures yield 84 deterministic scorer trials; four local quantized artifacts yield 96 calls and 192 model-case-arm trials. No model trial satisfies all five conditions, but this zero does not establish general capability absence. Eleven calls remain invalid after one retry; several commitments disclose the target distinction; the harness performs commits; deletion reuses a stateless call; and conflict changes multiple factors. Qwen2.5-7B answers every transfer and preservation item without revision state, exposing zero-state reconstruction.
  These failures make CMB-0.1 an instrument-calibration result rather than a model ranking. We derive a prospective, trace-anchored CMB-0.4 protocol requiring concealed transfer, explicit WRITE/NO-WRITE/ESCALATE actions, a separately logged policy-selected commit, matched interventions, repeated hidden items, and a frozen executable oracle. It is a successor design, not a completed confirmatory result. The paper contributes a measurement chain, an empirical diagnosis of its first implementation, and a more discriminating protocol for future tests of criterion revision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了CMB-0.1，一个用于检测语言模型代理是否形成并持续使用新标准（准则修订）的测量协议。在84次确定性评分试验和192次模型案例试验中，没有模型满足所有五个条件，但作者将这些失败归因于测量伪影，并提出了改进的CMB-0.4协议。
AI.motivation: 语言模型代理可能在失败后改进或在跨情节中携带文本，但不会修订其成功标准。现有研究缺乏对准则修订的精确归因方法，本文旨在解决这一测量问题。
AI.method: 提出了五个非补偿性条件（标准失败检测、模型提出、新情节迁移、对声称载体的干预敏感性、保持性），并设计CMB-0.1协议，包含12个跨领域案例和四种臂（无状态推理、仅追加历史、模型生成但由框架承诺的状态、评估者编写的预言状态）。使用七个机制固定装置和四个本地量化工件进行试验。
AI.result: 没有模型满足所有五个条件，但失败多源于测量设计缺陷，如提示泄露目标区分、框架执行提交、删除重用无状态调用等。Qwen2.5-7B在无修订状态的情况下回答所有迁移和保持项，暴露了零状态重构问题。
AI.conclusion: CMB-0.1的结果是仪器校准而非模型排名。作者提出了CMB-0.4协议，包含隐藏迁移、显式写/不写/升级操作、独立日志的策略选择提交、匹配干预、重复隐藏项目和冻结可执行预言。该协议是未来测试的更有区分度的设计，但尚未完成验证。

title: Breaking High Confidence: Practical Face Impersonation under High-Security Thresholds
summary: Face recognition systems (FRSs) are increasingly deployed in critical real-world services for authentication, such as banking applications and airport identity checks, necessitating stringent security configurations. Consequently, the security vulnerabilities of FRSs have garnered significant attention. While existing studies have extensively explored FRS security, prior analyses have primarily focused on medium-security threshold settings, which are not directly applicable to FRSs operating under high-security constraints. In this paper, we propose the first successful impersonation attack against FRSs under high-security threshold settings. Among various threat models, we focus on a practical and challenging scenario: score-based impersonation attacks under strict rate limits. To precisely evaluate the feasibility of such attacks, we provide a principled mathematical analysis characterizing the gaps in each stage of the attack pipeline. Our method significantly enhances impersonation capabilities in score-based attacks, even under elevated decision thresholds. On the LFW benchmark, with a budget of only 100 confidence score queries per identity, our attack achieves an impersonation success rate exceeding 92\% against Amazon Rekognition at a confidence score threshold of 99-recommended setting for law enforcement scenarios. We further observe consistently robust performance across multiple open-source FRSs evaluated at similarly stringent decision thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出了针对高安全阈值下人脸识别系统的成功冒充攻击，即使在严格查询限制下也能达到高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注中等安全阈值设置下的攻击，但实际中高安全场景（如执法）需要更高的阈值，因此需要研究该场景下的攻击可行性。
AI.method: 通过数学分析刻画攻击流程各阶段的差距，并提出一种基于分数查询的冒充攻击方法，在严格限率条件下优化查询策略。
AI.result: 在LFW基准上，使用100次查询预算，针对Amazon Rekognition在99%阈值下实现了超过92%的冒充成功率，并在多个开源FRS上表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: 即使在高安全阈值下，人脸识别系统仍可能受到冒充攻击，现有防御措施需要针对此场景进行加强。

title: Continuous-Time Quantum Walks based Graph Neural Network
summary:
Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used on graph-structured data, but most suffer from two key weaknesses. First, message passing behaves as a low-pass filter under the homophily assumption, leading to poor performance on heterophilic graphs. Second, stacking layers drives node features toward constants, causing over-smoothing. Existing methods usually address these issues separately, while the few joint solutions rely largely on empirical heuristics, and many over-smoothing remedies sacrifice model expressiveness.
  We propose \textbf{CTQW-GNN}, a GNN based on Continuous-Time Quantum Walks (CTQW), to address both issues with theoretical justification. Its design exploits two properties of the CTQW propagator $e^{-\mathrm{i}Ht}$. First, it is unitary and has eigenvalues on the unit circle, so no frequency component is damped, counteracting the low-pass bias. Second, unitarity preserves feature norms and prevents the Dirichlet energy from decaying exponentially with depth, thereby mitigating over-smoothing.
  CTQW-GNN combines three complementary aggregation modules. \textit{CTQW-based Aggregation} evolves node features through the unitary propagator, preserving mid- and high-frequency signals for heterophilic graphs while preventing Dirichlet-energy collapse. \textit{CTQW-Attention Aggregation} constructs a multi-hop neighbor graph from CTQW amplitudes and applies attention over it, enabling access to distant homophilic nodes missed by single-hop aggregation. \textit{LF Aggregation} uses a standard low-pass GAT branch to retain strong performance on homophilic graphs, where pure CTQW aggregation can be suboptimal. We further provide a spectral-gap analysis explaining energy preservation and a Lieb--Robinson-type bound that gives a principled rule for selecting the walk time $t$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CTQW-GNN，基于连续时间量子行走，通过保持特征范数统一处理异配图上的低通滤波问题和过平滑问题，并引入注意力与低通分支以兼顾同配图性能，提供谱隙分析和Lieb-Robinson界指导超参数选择。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN在异配图上性能差且易过平滑，现有方法分别处理但缺乏理论支撑，且缓解过平滑常牺牲表达力，亟需统一且理论化的解决方案。
AI.method: 利用CTQW传播子的酉性（单位圆特征值）避免频率衰减，并通过三模块：CTQW聚合（保留中高频）、CTQW注意力聚合（多跳邻域）、低通GAT分支（强化同配），同时给出谱隙分析和Lieb-Robinson界以选择行走时间t。
AI.result: 理论分析证明该方法能保持Dirichlet能量避免过平滑，且能适应异配图；实验部分未在摘要中给出，但预期在异配和同配图均有效。
AI.conclusion: CTQW-GNN为GNN异配与过平滑问题提供统一且理论严谨的解法，并通过多分支聚合兼顾不同同配性场景，性能有望优于现有方法。

title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) interleaves retrieval, reasoning, and answer generation across multiple hops. A retrieval error at hop 1 can surface only as a wrong answer at hop 3, while later retrieval can also repair the trajectory. This paper introduces AgenticRAG-FP, an interventional benchmark for causal failure attribution in agentic RAG. The benchmark injects a certified fault at a specified hop, re-executes the downstream trajectory, and evaluates diagnosers against the known intervention. Its central question is whether a post-hoc trace still identifies the injected hop after the suffix changes. In the completed strict dense Claude Haiku 4.5 sweep on 80 three-hop MuSiQue questions, coverage-based diagnosis is 0.91 at hop 1 and 0.00 at hops 2 and 3 (n=43,36,21 failed trajectories). A smaller content-corruption study changes an answer-bearing or bridge fact in topically intact evidence. At depth 2, where 18 failed cases remain after filtering, coverage-based diagnosis is 0.00 and a frozen-hop counterfactual probe is 0.67 in an exploratory pooled comparison. Depth-3 content estimates are descriptive only because they contain three failed cases. These results make propagation depth an explicit evaluation axis for diagnosing agentic RAG failures while distinguishing broad evidence of post-hoc signal loss from small-sample method comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgenticRAG-FP基准，用于在agentic RAG中因果归因检索失败。实验发现基于覆盖度的诊断在深层跳数上失效，而冻结跳反事实探针在某些情况下有效。
AI.motivation: 在agentic RAG中，检索错误可能在后继步骤才显现，使得事后追踪难以归因到具体跳数。现有基准缺乏对失败传播深度的因果评估，需要干预式基准来验证诊断方法的有效性。
AI.method: 构建干预式基准AgenticRAG-FP，在指定跳注入已知故障，重执行下游轨迹，并比较不同诊断器（如覆盖度诊断、冻结跳反事实探针）在严格和内容腐蚀设置下的性能。
AI.result: 严格扫描中，覆盖度诊断在跳1准确率为0.91，跳2和跳3为0.00；内容腐蚀中，深度2覆盖度诊断0.00，冻结跳探针0.67（探索性小样本）；深度3结果仅描述性。
AI.conclusion: 传播深度应作为诊断agentic RAG失败的重要评估维度，覆盖度诊断在深层失效，而反事实探针可能提供补充信息，但需更大样本验证。

title: JuryProbe: An Empirical Consensus-Risk Diagnostic for Routing Reference-Free Factuality Judge Panels to Grounded Verification
summary: Panels of inexpensive LLM judges increasingly make accept-or-escalate decisions. In factuality settings, accepting a claim because several reference-free judges agree can create a hidden risk: agreement may reflect shared false-negative blind spots rather than independent evidence. We introduce JuryProbe, an empirical consensus-risk diagnostic for reference-free factuality judge panels, paired with a calibration-based routing policy. JuryProbe estimates consensus risk from a labeled calibration probe using false-negative-only (FN-only) judge correlation and false-consensus lift; when flagged high-risk, reference-free majority accepts are routed to the same judges with trusted references. On audited FEVER corruptions, reference-free panels show correlated false negatives (FN-only correlations 0.402 and 0.368; lifts 3.13x and 18.13x), while unanimous false consensus drops to zero under a trusted-reference best-case diagnostic on both minimal-pair and non-minimal-pair evidence. In flagged settings, the routed policy is by construction equivalent to grounding every reference-free majority accept (verified in 34/34 splits): improvement comes from accept-conditioned grounding, while the diagnostic determines whether to activate it. A fixed, pre-specified rule flags 8-10 of 10 splits across synthetic, benchmark-authored, and scientific families and 0 of 10 on a negative control, where standing down avoids 28% of reference acquisitions at a 0.004 increase in false accepts. False-accept reduction persists under weak BM25 retrieval at substantial coverage cost, while stale stand-down labels require periodic recalibration. JuryProbe provides no formal risk guarantee and does not establish reliable stand-down on natural panels; its supported contribution is an empirical diagnostic of high-risk panel error dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JuryProbe，一种针对无参考事实性法官小组的共识风险诊断工具，并配套基于校准的路由策略。研究发现无参考法官小组存在相关的假阴性盲点，导致一致接受可能隐藏风险；JuryProbe 通过标记校准数据估计风险，并在高风险时将接受路由到带可信参考的法官。在审计的 FEVER 腐败数据上，高风险标志触发路由，显著减少虚假接受，但以覆盖率为代价，且无正式风险保证。
AI.motivation: 无参考法官小组的一致接受可能反映共享的假阴性盲点而非独立证据，导致事实性错误被隐藏，需要诊断和缓解这种共识风险。
AI.method: JuryProbe 使用标记的校准探针，通过仅假阴性（FN-only）法官相关性和假共识提升（false-consensus lift）估计共识风险；当风险高时，将无参考多数接受路由到带可信参考的同一法官。
AI.result: 在审计的 FEVER 腐败数据上，无参考小组表现出高 FN-only 相关性（0.402 和 0.368）和提升（3.13x 和 18.13x），而带参考的基准下虚假共识降至零；路由策略在 34/34 分裂中验证有效，固定规则在 8-10/10 分裂标志高风险，并在负控制中 0/10 标志，避免了 28% 的参考获取且仅增加 0.004 的虚假接受；弱检索下虚假接受减少但覆盖成本高。
AI.conclusion: JuryProbe 提供了经验性的高风险共识依赖性诊断，但不提供正式保证或自然面板的可靠下线；其贡献在于识别高风险面板并触发路由以降低虚假接受。

title: Sparse Token Routing in Efficient Transformers
summary: Efficient-transformer research often motivates token pruning and adaptive computation with the claim that not all tokens require equal computational effort. We test this claim end to end using SEWN, a two-stream Transformer that routes tokens through either lightweight or full-capacity processing using a learned gate. Across our experiments, routing introduces negligible accuracy change relative to parameter-matched baselines, while the gate's token-importance signal depends critically on how it is learned. A static lexicon-seeded prior fails a counterfactual faithfulness test on BoolQ, whereas a fully contextual gate achieves highly significant separation ($p<10^{-10}$) on both evaluated tasks without changing task accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双流Transformer架构SEWN，通过门控机制将token路由到轻量级或全容量处理路径，在保持精度的同时实现高效计算。实验发现，路由对精度影响可忽略，而门控的token重要性信号严重依赖其学习方式。
AI.motivation: 验证高效Transformer研究中'并非所有token都需要相同计算量'的假设，并探究token路由对模型性能的影响。
AI.method: 设计SEWN（双流Transformer），使用可学习的门控将token路由到轻量级或全容量路径，并与参数匹配的基线比较；同时评估静态词典先验门和全上下文门的效果。
AI.result: 路由引入的精度变化可忽略；静态词典先验门在BoolQ上未能通过反事实忠实性测试，而全上下文门在两个任务上均达到高度显著分离（p<10^-10）且不改变任务精度。
AI.conclusion: token路由可以在不损失精度的情况下提升效率，但门控的token重要性信号必须基于完整的上下文学习，而非静态先验。

title: Is Multimodal Speculative Decoding Ready for Diffusion-Based Parallel Drafting? A Survey and Empirical Diagnosis
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by allowing a lightweight drafter to propose future tokens while a target model verifies them in parallel. Its lossless guarantee has motivated a line of work that pushes the drafter itself toward parallel generation. The most recent paradigm is block-parallel generative drafting, including diffusion-based methods such as DFlash and DSpark, achieving up to 3.6x speedup on common daily chatting tasks. While this transition is well studied in text-only LLMs, its applicability to multimodal models remains an open question. Existing multimodal speculative decoding efforts focus on input compression, adapter alignment, candidate coverage, or modality-specific verification; however, block-parallel generative drafting remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, this paper combines a modality-centered survey with a cross-architecture empirical study to ask: Is multimodal speculative decoding ready for diffusion-based parallel drafting? In this survey, we systematically analyze a wide spectrum of multimodal models, spanning Vision-Language, Video-Language, Audio, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures, from the dual perspectives of drafting parallelism and cross-modal information interaction. We introduce a unified taxonomy that isolates drafter-side parallelism from orthogonal design choices such as tree construction and verification strategies. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive empirical comparison of existing methods under varying degrees of parallelism across standardized multimodal benchmarks, including OCR, VQA, visual reasoning, and image captioning. Finally, we summarize the limitations of current approaches, discuss open challenges, and outline promising future directions for this rapidly evolving field.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地探讨了多模态推测解码中扩散式并行草稿生成的可行性，通过综述和跨架构实验分析，提出了统一的分类法，并评估了现有方法在不同并行度下的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 文本LLM中的块并行生成式草稿（如扩散方法）已取得显著加速，但在多模态模型中尚未被探索。现有多模态推测解码研究主要集中于输入压缩、适配器对齐等，缺乏对块并行生成式草稿的适用性研究。
AI.method: 结合模态中心调查与跨架构实证研究，覆盖视觉-语言、视频-语言、音频和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构，从草稿并行性和跨模态信息交互两个角度分析，提出统一分类法，并在标准多模态基准上对现有方法进行实证比较。
AI.result: 发现扩散式并行草稿在多模态场景中具有潜力，但当前方法在并行度和跨模态交互方面存在局限；实证比较展示了不同方法在OCR、VQA、视觉推理和图像描述等任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 多模态推测解码尚未完全准备好采用扩散式并行草稿，需要进一步研究以解决跨模态交互和并行生成的挑战，并指出了未来研究方向。

title: EmotionDialogCN: A Spontaneous Multimodal Dataset for Mandarin Emotional Dialogue
summary: Face-to-face audiovisual interaction is central to human communication, conveying rich emotional and social cues. However, existing multimodal dialogue datasets remain limited by inadequate emotion annotations, poor emotional diversity, and small scale. We introduce EmotionDialogCN, a large-scale audiovisual-emotional dataset designed to capture authentic face-to-face communication. It contains 21,880 dialogue sessions performed by 119 professional actors across 20 everyday scenarios, covering 18 emotion categories with over 400 hours of recordings, the largest and most comprehensive dataset of its kind. A novel data collection framework minimizes equipment interference, enabling natural and nuanced emotional expressions. EmotionDialogCN achieves an emotion distribution deviation of 0.64 from real human emotion statistics (versus 5.65 for prior datasets) and consistent subject framing (52-59% frame occupancy). Together, these properties translate into stable unimodal and multimodal performance across acoustic, lexical, and visual modalities, with fusion results further underscoring strong multimodal alignment and cross-modal complementarity.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了EmotionDialogCN，一个大规模音视频情感对话数据集，包含21880个会话、400多小时记录、18种情感类别，情感分布更接近真实人类统计，且多模态性能稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有情感对话数据集存在情感标注不足、情感多样性差、规模小的问题，限制了多模态情感分析研究。
AI.method: 设计了新型数据采集框架以减少设备干扰，由119名专业演员在20个日常场景中表演，覆盖18种情感类别，构建了大规模音视频情感数据集。
AI.result: 情感分布偏差为0.64（对比先前数据集5.65），主体框占52-59%，在声学、词汇和视觉模态上单模态及多模态融合性能稳定，展现出良好的跨模态互补性。
AI.conclusion: EmotionDialogCN是当前最大、最全面的音视频情感对话数据集，能促进自然情感表达和多模态情感分析研究。

title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking
summary: Real-world image search queries are multimodal and compositional: ``find this shirt in pink'' specifies an entity to retain, an attribute to modify, and context to ignore. Yet existing re-rankers either compress such multifaceted relevance into an opaque embedding or rely on free-form chain-of-thought that easily omits or hallucinates fine-grained constraints. Drawing on rubric- and checklist-based evaluation from NLP, we recast multimodal image re-ranking as a semantic constraint satisfaction problem and propose EviRank, which parses any query - text-only, image-only, or composed - into a unified evidence package: typed criteria across six semantic slots (e.g., entities, attributes, relations), each labelled required, forbidden, or ignorable. Re-ranking then reduces to evidence-conditioned verification, combining deterministic rubric scoring and evidence-grounded listwise comparison in a single training-free procedure. The explicit evidence can further serve as structured supervision for optionally distilling a lightweight student. Across five benchmarks spanning text-to-image, image-to-image, and composed image retrieval, EviRank achieves state-of-the-art performance, and the distilled student preserves over 90% of the teacher's capability at substantially lower cost.

AI.tldr: 提出EviRank，将多模态图像重排序转化为语义约束满足问题，通过解析查询为证据包（六种语义槽、三类标签），结合确定性子规则评分与证据grounded列表比较，实现训练免费的重排序，并在五个基准上达到SOTA，蒸馏学生模型保留90%以上性能。
AI.motivation: 现有重排序器无法有效处理多模态组合查询（如“找这件衬衫的粉色款”），要么压缩为不透明嵌入丢失细粒度约束，要么依赖自由文本推理导致遗漏或幻觉。受NLP中rubric和checklist评估启发，探索将重排序形式化为语义约束满足问题。
AI.method: 解析查询（文本、图像或组合）为统一证据包，包含六种语义槽（实体、属性、关系等）和三类标签（必需、禁止、可忽略）；重排序采用证据条件验证，结合确定性子规则评分和证据grounded列表比较，全程无需训练；可选蒸馏轻量学生模型。
AI.result: 在文本到图像、图像到图像和组合图像检索五个基准上达到最先进性能；蒸馏学生模型以显著更低成本保留教师90%以上能力。
AI.conclusion: EviRank通过显式证据解析和验证，有效处理多模态组合查询，提升重排序性能，且可蒸馏轻量模型，兼顾效果与效率。

title: Natural-Language-Guided Generator-Agnostic Shortlisting for Protein Binder Design
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology
summary: Modern de novo design workflows generate many candidate protein binders, but wet-lab validation capacity remains limited, making shortlisting a major bottleneck. We study whether LLMs can generate multi-metric ranking policies from precomputed structural-confidence and interface-quality proxy scores. Rather than proposing a new protein binder design pipeline, we focus on post-generation binder shortlisting: selecting the final top-K candidates from already generated binder pools using a shared panel of precomputed proxy scores. On the 10-target held-out split, averaging performance over five sampled global iterative gpt-4o policies reaches 0.589 Recall@10, modestly improving over the strongest single-feature fixed baseline, Protenix binder ipTM, which reaches 0.571 Recall@10. On the 3-target held-out subset comprising Nipah, RBX1, and TREM2, target-conditioned iterative gpt-5.4 policies reach the strongest LLM performance, with 0.519 Recall@10 and 0.583 NDCG@10. These results suggest that LLM-generated ranking policies can act as an interpretable post-generation decision layer for combining heterogeneous proxy metrics to prioritize binders from large candidate pools.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM能否从预计算的代理分数生成多指标排序策略，用于蛋白结合剂候选物筛选。在后代筛选任务中，GPT-4o策略在10靶标上达到0.589的Recall@10，略优于最佳单特征基线，GPT-5.4在特定靶标上表现最佳。结果表明LLM生成的排序策略可作为可解释的后处理决策层。
AI.motivation: 现代从头设计流程生成大量候选蛋白结合剂，但湿实验验证能力有限，候选物排序成为瓶颈。作者探索LLM是否能从结构置信度和界面质量的代理分数生成多指标排序策略，以改进筛选效率。
AI.method: 使用LLM（如GPT-4o和GPT-5.4）生成全局或靶标条件的迭代排序策略，基于预计算的代理分数（如Protenix binder ipTM）对候选物池进行排名，选择Top-K。
AI.conclusion: 在10靶标上，GPT-4o策略的平均Recall@10为0.589，优于单特征基线（0.571）。在3靶标子集上，GPT-5.4靶标条件策略达到0.519 Recall@10和0.583 NDCG@10。LLM生成的策略可作为整合异构代理指标的可解释后处理层，优先从大候选池中筛选结合剂。

title: Beyond Endpoint Gains: A Weight-Delta Audit of Medical Specialization
summary: Specialist language models are usually understood through endpoint gains: the generalist scores lower, the specialist scores higher, and the difference is treated as evidence of specialization. This leaves the released update itself largely unexamined. We propose a paired weight-delta path audit and apply it to two public, aligned generalist-to-medical-specialist checkpoint pairs: Gemma-3-4B-IT to MedGemma-4B-IT and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to HuatuoGPT-o1-7B. In both pairs, the full decoder-side update strongly reconstructs measured medical benchmark movement (0.974 and 1.183 endpoint-normalized retention), making each decoder delta an appropriate substrate for the audit. Yet the movement is not cleanly localized. MLP is the strongest broad component family in both pairs, but mixed off-domain movements, 10-seed matched controls, and endpoint-anchored rollbacks prevent a unique coarse-family explanation. The audit therefore separates update-level reconstruction from component-level explanation. Its claims concern text-only multiple-choice benchmark movement, not clinical validation, repair, or circuit-level mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种配对权重增量路径审计方法，应用于两个医疗专用模型检查点对，发现解码器更新能重建基准测试移动，但无法将移动干净地定位到单一组件族。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅关注端点性能差异，忽略了更新本身的结构，无法解释专用化具体发生在何处。
AI.method: 对Gemma-3-4B-IT到MedGemma-4B-IT和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct到HuatuoGPT-o1-7B的配对检查点，进行解码器权重增量路径审计，结合MLP组件分析、10种子对照和端点锚定回滚。
AI.result: 解码器更新能强烈重建医疗基准移动（保留率0.974和1.183），但移动并非局部化，MLP是最强组件族，但存在混合无关领域移动，无法给出唯一粗粒度解释。
AI.conclusion: 审计区分了更新级重建与组件级解释，声称仅涉及文本多项选择基准移动，不涉及临床验证、修复或电路机制。

title: AgentMercury: Your Agent Can Synthesize Verifiable Environments for Business Scenarios at scale
summary: Agents learn to act through interaction with environments, yet the environments used for training are often manually constructed or synthesized around predefined tasks and benchmarks. This task-centric paradigm makes it difficult to scale environments that reflect realistic and evolving workflows where diverse tasks can naturally emerge from the underlying world. We introduce AgentMercury, a scalable framework for synthesizing executable environments from high-level business scenarios. Rather than constructing an environment for a specific task, AgentMercury first instantiates a persistent world with entities, services, tools, state, and executable cross-service invariants, from which diverse tasks and interaction trajectories can subsequently emerge. We construct 4,783 executable environments spanning 14 industries and 50 countries, and use them as training substrates for reinforcement learning. Despite being generated without targeting the evaluation benchmarks, policies trained on these business-oriented environments improve substantially on both enterprise workflows and out-of-domain benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, scientific computing, and tool use. In our experiments, Qwen3.5-4B improves from 12.3 to 15.7 on EnterpriseOps-GYM and from 45.9 to 56.0 on AIME26 after training on AgentMercury environments. We further show that the construction process itself can be learned: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on construction traces increases executable-world authoring success from 3.3% to 83.3% on held-out business scenarios. These results show that scenario-grounded environments can provide useful and generalizable learning signals beyond benchmark-specific training, while their construction can itself become a learnable capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentMercury，一个从高层业务场景合成可执行环境的框架，生成跨行业和国家的环境用于强化学习训练，显著提升模型在多个基准上的表现，并展示了环境构建本身可被学习。
AI.motivation: 现有训练环境多围绕特定任务和基准手工构建，难以扩展至反映现实复杂工作流的多样化场景，导致智能体缺乏通用和可迁移的学习信号。
AI.method: AgentMercury首先生成包含实体、服务、工具、状态及可执行跨服务不变量的持久世界，从中涌现任务和交互轨迹；构建了覆盖14个行业和50个国家的4783个可执行环境，并用于强化学习训练；同时，利用构建轨迹微调模型以学习环境构建过程。
AI.result: 训练后的Qwen3.5-4B在EnterpriseOps-GYM上从12.3提升至15.7，在AIME26上从45.9提升至56.0；在保留业务场景中，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的可执行世界创作成功率从3.3%提升至83.3%。
AI.conclusion: 场景化环境能提供超越基准专用训练的通用学习信号，且环境构建本身可被学习，为可扩展环境合成和通用智能体训练开辟了新途径。

title: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter
summary: With large pretrained models, existing methods have effectively improved instruction-based video editing. However, most of them rely on an in-place editing assumption. They align the edited video with the given source clip frame by frame over a fixed time span. This pattern fails for open-ended streams, e.g., restyling a live game or applying a camera move to an ongoing shot. In such cases, edits must extend to future frames as they arrive, rather than be applied to a static input clip. In this paper, we study this setting and name it infinite video editing: given a preceding segment and an edit request, a model must generate the next segment that continues the stream while applying the requested edit. This process repeats as an unbounded sequence of edit instructions arrives. This task brings two challenges: the edit must be a faithful continuation rather than a frame-wise rewrite, and generation quality must remain stable as edits accumulate. To address them, we first design a data-collection pipeline for infinite video editing. Based on the collected data, we propose InfinityEdit, a lightweight edit adapter that equips a streaming video generator with unbounded editing ability. The adapter contains three attention modules. History cross-attention guides the denoising frames using the input frames. Temporal causal self-attention keeps temporal cues flowing only from earlier frames to later ones. Edit cross-attention injects the edit request into generation. During inference, the adapter is activated only in the chunk where an edit request arrives. Subsequent chunks are generated by the original model with a reset anchor frame. This scheme applies the edit while preserving the original model's infinite generation ability. Extensive experiments show that InfinityEdit faithfully continues the stream under each edit, and stays stable over unbounded edit sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出无限视频编辑任务，并设计数据收集流程与轻量适配器InfinityEdit，使流式视频生成器具备在持续视频流中应用编辑的能力，同时保持生成稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有指令视频编辑方法假设输入片段固定，无法处理开放式视频流（如直播、连续场景）的编辑需求，编辑必须扩展到未来帧而非仅在静态片段上操作。
AI.method: 设计数据收集流程用于构建训练数据；提出InfinityEdit轻量适配器，包含历史交叉注意力、时间因果自注意力和编辑交叉注意力三个模块，仅在编辑请求到达的分块激活，后续分块由原模型生成，以保持无限生成能力。
AI.result: 实验表明InfinityEdit在每个编辑请求下忠实延续视频流，并在无限编辑序列中保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: InfinityEdit成功实现了无限视频编辑，兼顾编辑忠实性与长期稳定性，为开放式视频流编辑提供了有效方案。

title: MIL-BERT: Classification of Arbitrarily Large Text with Performance and Explanatory Guarantees
summary: Many text classification decisions are viable based on constituent excerpts alone. Taking inspiration from the field of multiple instance learning, we present an algorithm for training a neural network to classify text by selecting such excerpts. We show that our approach is also scalable with demonstrated learning against samples with nearly 1M tokens. We evaluate our methods on 7 datasets with emphasis on long-textual collections that far exceed the encoding limit of our base model. We present state-of-the-art results with this algorithm on 3 datasets: identification of political bias in news outlets, trigger warnings in long stories, and demographic characteristics of authors in tweet collections. Furthermore, the model trained on weakly-labeled collections of text (bags) generalizes to accurately classify constituent, smaller instances. Besides a new state-of-the-art for these problems, this approach is one of the few neural methods to excel in these datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多实例学习的神经网络算法，通过选择文本中的关键片段进行文本分类，在长文本数据集上表现优异，并在三个数据集上取得了最先进的结果。
AI.motivation: 许多文本分类任务可以基于文本中的关键片段完成，而现有方法在处理超出模型编码限制的长文本时面临挑战。
AI.method: 借鉴多实例学习的思想，训练神经网络自动选择文本中的关键片段进行分类，使模型能够处理近百万token的样本。
AI.result: 在7个数据集上评估，其中在政治偏见识别、触发警告和作者人口特征分类上达到最先进水平，且弱监督训练后能准确分类更小的实例。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅解决了长文本分类问题，还展示了在弱标签下的泛化能力，是少数在此类数据集上表现优异的神经方法之一。

title: Explainable Deepfake Detection with Feature-robust Augmentation and Evidence-grounded Explanation Optimization
summary: Explainable deepfake detection extends binary classification by requiring models to not only predict authenticity but also provide interpretable justifications. This expanded scope is critical in practice, where users like forensic analysts need insight into the rationale behind the detection. Despite advancements, current approaches suffer from two critical deficiencies: (1)vulnerability to image quality degradation: detection accuracy plummets on low-quality samples, while naive augmentation strategies may induce feature drift and impair performance as diversity expands. (2) factually flawed explanations: explanation models may omit manipulation evidence or hallucinate irrelevant details, undermining interpretability. To address it, we propose a framework with two innovations. For robust deepfake detection, we introduce Feature-robust Augmentation, which comprises diversified degradation-aware augmentation strategies, and a supervised contrastive learning pattern paired with a mean-teacher architecture that stabilizes features against augmentations through consistency constraints. For explanation, we devise an evidence-grounded preference optimization process that guides model to prioritize genuine manipulation traces by learning from chosen-rejected explanation pairs, where rejected samples are constructed via evidence omission or irrelevant information injection. The proposed approach wins the first place in ACM Multimedia 2026 Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge.The code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/EDD.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可解释深度伪造检测框架，通过特征鲁棒增强和证据偏好优化，解决低质量图像下检测精度下降和解释不准确的问题，并在ACM MM 2026挑战赛中获得第一。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释深度伪造检测方法在低质量图像下检测性能下降，且解释模型可能遗漏伪造证据或产生无关信息，缺乏鲁棒性和可信度。
AI.method: 提出两个创新：一是特征鲁棒增强，包括多样化退化感知增强策略和监督对比学习与均值教师架构，通过一致性约束稳定特征；二是证据偏好优化，通过构造遗漏/注入无关信息的正反样本对，引导模型优先关注真实篡改痕迹。
AI.result: 在ACM Multimedia 2026可解释深度伪造检测挑战赛中获得第一名，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效提升了低质量深度伪造检测的鲁棒性和解释的准确性，为可解释检测提供了新方向。

title: CAS: Conformalized Agentic Search via Adaptive Retrieval and Policy Weighting
comment: 21 pages, including figures, tables, and appendix
summary:
Search Agents face a severe reliability crisis during reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning. Heuristic Top-K retrieval often causes critical evidence loss or noise inclusion, while over-confidence induced by progressive RL leads to hallucinated answers and redundant searches.
  To build highly reliable agents, we introduce Conformal Prediction (CP) and propose Conformalized Agentic Search (CAS). This framework establishes reliability guarantees on both the retrieval and training sides: on the retrieval side, an Adaptive Prediction Set (APS), a specific CP realization, translates statistical coverage into dynamic document truncation to construct prediction sets that are adaptive in size; on the training side, Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI), a dynamic CP algorithm, dynamically constructs prediction sets with controllable coverage to quantify answer confidence, which is then used to penalize low-confidence trajectories within the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective, ensuring the model learns only from reliable ones.
  Experiments across single-hop and multi-hop QA datasets demonstrate that our framework significantly improves reasoning accuracy while drastically reducing redundant tool invocations, establishing a highly reliable and efficient agent paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/S1llyBird/CAS.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合共形预测的智能体搜索框架，在检索和训练两侧提供可靠性保证，显著提升推理准确率并减少冗余工具调用。
AI.motivation: 搜索智能体在强化学习微调中面临可靠性危机，启发式Top-K检索导致关键证据丢失或噪声引入，且过度自信导致幻觉答案和冗余搜索。
AI.method: 提出Conformalized Agentic Search (CAS)框架，检索侧使用自适应预测集(APS)进行动态文档截断；训练侧使用动态共形推断(ACI)构建预测集以量化答案置信度，并将其纳入GRPO目标以惩罚低置信轨迹。
AI.result: 在单跳和多跳问答数据集上，显著提升推理准确率，大幅减少冗余工具调用，建立高可靠高效智能体范式。
AI.conclusion: 共形预测可为搜索智能体提供可靠性保证，有效缓解证据丢失、噪声和过度自信问题，提升智能体可靠性及效率。

title: Semantically Compatible Knowledge Distillation for Cross-Domain Object Detection with Vision Foundation Models
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) offer strong generalization capabilities for domain-adaptive object detection (DAOD). However, existing VFM-based methods overlook the spatial-scale discrepancy between teacher and student feature maps, resulting in semantic incompatibility that weakens both feature alignment and pseudo-label learning. Moreover, domain shift can cause source-trained VFM teachers to miss target-domain objects, limiting the quality of their pseudo-labels. To address these issues, we propose the Semantic Localization-Enhanced Teacher (SLE-T), a semantically compatible knowledge-distillation framework built around a lightweight SLE Adapter for DINOv2. SLE Adapter injects pretrained local-texture priors into DINOv2 to improve cross-domain recognition and reformulates its features into dense representations that are spatially and semantically compatible with the student detector. SLE-T transfers the resulting teacher knowledge through either pseudo-label learning or feature alignment. We instantiate SLE-T with DINOv2-B and DINOv2-L (the ViT-B and ViT-L variants) and compare them with the larger DINOv2-G teacher. Extensive experiments on three DAOD benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, and ablation studies confirm the importance of teacher-student semantic compatibility. Notably, SLE-T with DINOv2-B produces competitive or superior pseudo-labels using approximately one-quarter of the training time of DINOv2-G and substantially less GPU memory, demonstrating efficient VFM knowledge transfer under limited computational resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SLE-T，一种基于语义定位增强教师的知识蒸馏框架，通过SLE适配器将DINOv2的密集特征与检测器对齐，在领域自适应目标检测中取得SOTA性能，且计算开销显著降低。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VFM的方法忽略师生特征图间的空间尺度差异，导致语义不兼容，削弱特征对齐和伪标签学习；同时，域偏移使源域训练的教师漏检目标域对象，降低伪标签质量。
AI.method: 引入轻量级SLE适配器注入预训练局部纹理先验到DINOv2，提升跨域识别，并将特征重构为与学生检测器空间语义兼容的密集表示；通过伪标签学习或特征对齐传递教师知识。
AI.result: 在三个DAOD基准上达到SOTA；DINOv2-B教师产生与DINOv2-G相当或更优的伪标签，训练时间约为其四分之一，GPU内存大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: 师生语义兼容性至关重要，SLE-T实现高效且有效的VFM知识迁移，适合计算资源受限场景。

title: Directional Contextual Representations for Dependency Relations: Why Cross-Direction Pairing Fails
summary: Splitting a bidirectional LSTM's contextual representation into a forward-only $F_i$ (strictly a function of tokens $1..i$) and a backward-only $B_i$ (strictly a function of tokens $i..n$) beats either alone and beats a fused self-attention representation for dependency relation-type classification. But a specific, natural extension of this idea -- pairing a token's forward state against a \emph{candidate}'s backward state (``cross-direction'' pairing, $F_i$ vs.\ $B_j$) -- consistently \emph{underperforms} same-direction pairing, and the penalty \emph{grows}, not shrinks, with token distance, both paired-bootstrap significant. We diagnose why using a frozen-trunk methodology: architectural information leakage between directions is impossible by construction (a single-layer BiLSTM, verified by code inspection); 93\% of the same-vs-cross gap survives freezing the trunk and training only fresh heads, ruling out training-co-adaptation as the primary cause; linear regression shows partial representational redundancy between $F_i$ and $B_i$ ($R^2{=}0.324$ vs.\ $0.028$ for a shuffled control) and a linear probe shows partial anticipatory encoding of upcoming tokens in $F_i$ (36.5\% vs.\ 17.2\% majority baseline) -- real effects, but neither alone, nor combined, cleanly explains the full gap. Extended frozen-trunk diagnostics (a positional probe and a distance-decay probe) show directional information is genuinely stored but not exactly positioned, and propagates only a few tokens before decaying to baseline -- consistent with, and mechanistically underneath, the distance-growth finding.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在双向LSTM中，前向表示F_i与后向表示B_i的同向配对优于交叉配对（F_i与B_j），且差距随距离增大而增大。通过冻结主干实验排除训练共适应，诊断出信息冗余与提前编码等部分原因，但无法完全解释差距。
AI.motivation: 探索双向LSTM中不同方向表示组合方式对依赖关系分类的影响，并解释同向优于交叉这一反直觉现象。
AI.method: 使用单层双向LSTM，对比同向配对（F_i vs B_i）与交叉配对（F_i vs B_j）的性能；采用冻结主干方法隔离训练共适应；通过线性回归、线性探针、位置探针和距离衰减探针进行诊断。
AI.result: 同向配对优于交叉配对，且差距随距离增大；冻结主干后差距保留93%；F_i与B_i存在部分冗余（R²=0.324），F_i有提前编码（36.5% vs 17.2%基线）；方向信息存储但不精确定位，传播范围短。
AI.conclusion: 同向配对优势主要由架构信息泄漏或训练共适应之外的因素引起，可能是表示冗余与提前编码的交互，但现有诊断无法完全解释，提示需要更深入的机制研究。

title: AsmEvo: Agentic Assembly-Level Optimization of AMD GPU Kernels with Functional Equivalence Verification
summary:
High-performance ML systems increasingly rely on GPU kernels whose editable source is unavailable, generated, or too distant from final machine code to expose remaining optimizations. Existing LLM kernel optimizers and autotuners mainly operate on CUDA, Triton, HIP, or tensor-program source and validate against reference implementations. We study a stricter setting: optimizing an already compiled AMDGPU code object, where the deployed binary is the only behavioral oracle.
  We present AsmEvo, an agentic assembly-level optimizer for AMD GPU kernels. Given an AMDGPU code object K0, AsmEvo reconstructs a reassemblable representation, proposes low-level edits with a long-horizon agent, rebuilds an ABI-preserving optimized object, and accepts candidates only after differential verification against K0 under identical launches. AsmEvo combines code-object recovery, metadata-aware rebuilding, profiling-guided hot-window editing, correctness-gated timing, and conservative in-place patch fallback.
  We conduct extensive experiments with AsmEvo on various AMD GPU kernels. On MI308X, AsmEvo improves 29 of 30 selected KernelBench kernels, reaching 1.35x geometric-mean and 3.88x maximum speedup. On MI300X production workloads, it improves all evaluated AITer binaries and vLLM/SGLang Triton assembly kernels, reaching 1.09x/1.31x and 1.18x/1.34x geometric-mean/maximum speedups, respectively, while preserving functional equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AsmEvo，一种针对AMD GPU已编译二进制代码对象的汇编级智能优化器，可在无需源代码的情况下实现显著加速，并保证功能等价。
AI.motivation: 现有优化工具依赖源代码（如CUDA、Triton），但实际部署的GPU内核常缺乏可编辑源码或源码优化空间有限；已编译的AMDGPU代码对象是唯一可靠行为来源，因此需要一种直接优化二进制的方法。
AI.method: AsmEvo结合代码对象恢复、元数据感知重建、基于profile的热点编辑、正确性门控计时以及保守的原地补丁回退，通过智能体提出底层编辑，并重建ABI保持的优化对象，最终通过差分验证保证等价性。
AI.result: 在MI308X上，30个KernelBench内核中29个获得加速，几何平均1.35倍，最大3.88倍；在MI300X生产负载上，AITer和vLLM/SGLang Triton汇编内核均获得1.09-1.34倍加速，且功能等价。
AI.conclusion: AsmEvo证明直接优化已编译的AMDGPU二进制是可行的，能在无源码条件下实现显著性能提升，为闭源或生成内核的优化提供了新途径。

title: GAP-SAM: A Global Artifact Prior for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Manipulation Localization
summary: AI-generated image manipulation localization identifies edited pixels, but its OOD performance lags behind image-level detection partly because pixel supervision entangles forensic evidence with dataset-specific mask geometry and semantic boundaries. Extending image-level distribution alignment to localization, we construct COCO-ControlNet with source-image Canny edges and depth maps to align semantics and geometry, improving OOD performance across multiple localizers. Yet tighter Mask-VAE Reconstruction Alignment (Mask-VAE) underperforms COCO-ControlNet, showing that VAE reconstruction artifacts transfer poorly to local diffusion-inpainting artifacts. We also identify \emph{boundary adhesion}, where fine-tuned segmentation models snap predictions to semantic object contours rather than true manipulation boundaries. These findings motivate GAP-SAM, which encodes an image and its frozen VAE reconstruction into a global artifact token and injects it into SAM3's feature pyramid via zero-gated FiLM before pixel decoding. Without prescribing a spatial region, this token modulates dense decoding to preserve localization while suppressing semantic-boundary shortcuts. Across six datasets, GAP-SAM averages 79.8 Pixel-F1, outperforming the strongest prior method by 12.6 points. It also performs best at every tested severity of JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resizing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAP-SAM，通过全局伪造痕迹token注入SAM3，解决图像编辑定位中语义边界干扰和OOD泛化问题，平均Pixel-F1达79.8，优于现有方法12.6点。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像编辑定位的OOD性能落后于图像级检测，原因是像素级监督将取证痕迹与数据集特定的掩码几何和语义边界纠缠，且现有方法在跨数据集泛化时表现不佳。
AI.method: 构建COCO-ControlNet对齐语义和几何，发现Mask-VAE重建对齐效果不佳；识别边界粘连问题；提出GAP-SAM，将图像及其冻结VAE重建编码为全局痕迹token，通过零门控FiLM注入SAM3特征金字塔，调制密集解码。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上，GAP-SAM平均Pixel-F1为79.8，比最强现有方法高12.6点；在JPEG压缩、高斯模糊和缩放等各种强度下均表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: GAP-SAM通过全局痕迹token避免空间区域预设，有效抑制语义边界捷径，显著提升定位精度和鲁棒性，为图像编辑定位提供了新范式。

title: PSK at WMT 2026 MIST: Task-Specialized QLoRA Adapters for Multilingual Summarization and Question Answering
summary: We describe the PSK submission to the WMT 2026 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task. Our system uses the 3.35B-parameter Tiny Aya Global model with three QLoRA adapters, one for each task. The adapters are trained on multilingual document-summary pairs, passage-based question answering, and filtered standalone question answering. The summarization data also includes scientific papers with their author-written abstracts. On our held-out split, the context and summarization adapters perform better than our multitask adapter, which was trained only on data supplied by the organizers. Results for open QA are mixed and vary with answer length and evaluation method. We therefore submit three systems with the same context and summarization adapters but different open-QA adapters.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了PSK系统在WMT 2026多语言指令共享任务中的提交，使用Tiny Aya Global模型和三个QLoRA适配器，分别针对总结、段落问答和独立问答任务。
AI.motivation: 多语言指令任务需要高效适配不同子任务，且资源有限，因此探索轻量级适配器方法。
AI.method: 采用3.35B参数的Tiny Aya Global模型，训练三个QLoRA适配器，分别基于文档摘要、段落问答和过滤后的独立问答数据。
AI.result: 在保留集上，上下文和总结适配器优于多任务适配器；开放问答结果因答案长度和评估方法而异。
AI.conclusion: 提交三个系统，共享上下文和总结适配器，但使用不同的开放问答适配器以优化性能。

title: Automated Trajectory Evaluation for Mobile Agents via Step-Level Consequence Reasoning and Aggregation
summary: Evaluating language-guided mobile agents has recently shifted from rule-based to model-based approaches to achieve scalable and automated assessments. However, existing holistic evaluation paradigms process entire trajectories at once, leading to substantial context overload. Moreover, they primarily focus on task completion while overlooking operational safety. To address these limitations, we introduce CRATE, a novel two-stage VLM-as-judge framework for automated mobile agent evaluation that is compatible with both open- and closed-source models. Leveraging a step-level consequence reasoning mechanism, CRATE independently extracts task-relevant visual clues and infers action-conditioned state changes at each step. The resulting step-level textual evidence is then synthesized through trajectory-level aggregation to deliver an evidence-grounded evaluation of task completion. Building upon this evaluation scheme, we further extend CRATE to CRATE-S for operational safety assessment. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness and robustness of both CRATE and CRATE-S. Powered by Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct, CRATE achieves an F1-score of 0.833 on AndroidWorld (outperforming SPA-Bench by 20%), while CRATE-S reaches an F1-score of 0.697 on MobileRisk, demonstrating strong alignment with benchmark ground truths. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CRATE-D580.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRATE，一种两阶段VLM评判框架，用于自动评估移动智能体，通过逐步推理和轨迹聚合减少上下文过载，并扩展至安全评估，在AndroidWorld和MobileRisk基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有移动智能体评估方法从规则转向模型，但整体处理轨迹导致上下文过载，且仅关注任务完成而忽视操作安全。
AI.method: CRATE采用两阶段VLM评判，逐步提取视觉线索并推断动作导致的状态变化，生成逐步证据，再通过轨迹聚合得到任务完成评估；扩展CRATE-S用于安全评估。
AI.result: 使用Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct，CRATE在AndroidWorld上F1达0.833（优于SPA-Bench 20%），CRATE-S在MobileRisk上F1达0.697，与基准真理高度一致。
AI.conclusion: CRATE和CRATE-S有效且鲁棒，为移动智能体自动化评估提供了可靠方案，兼容开源和闭源模型。

title: Tree-of-Concerns: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Debate for Unstated-Limitation Extraction in Scientific Critique
comment: Accepted in the Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: As scientific literature grows and papers increasingly under-report limitations, multi-agent LLMs offer a promising approach to systematically uncover these hidden failure modes. Here, we introduce Tree-of-Concerns, a multi-agent framework that deploys specialized skeptic personas, each operating through a category-specific analytical lens, as parallel debate trees to extract unstated limitations from scientific papers. Each persona conducts structured, evidence-grounded argumentation, while a Panel Review mechanism re-evaluates each surviving claim from all five perspectives to correct category drift and severity miscalibration. Through experiments on ToC-Bench, our benchmark of 414 research papers with 1,905 unstated limitations, sourced from reviewer-reported weaknesses and follow-up citation critiques, we demonstrate that ToC improves precision by 79% and coverage by 11% relative to strongest baselines, surfacing specific, evidence-grounded concerns that support reviewers in systematic evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出Tree-of-Concerns框架，利用多智能体LLM和专家角色辩论树，从论文中提取未陈述的局限性，在ToC-Bench基准上显著提升了精确率和覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 科学文献数量激增，且论文常低估未报告的限制，需要自动化方法系统揭示隐藏的失败模式。
AI.method: 采用多智能体LLM框架Tree-of-Concerns，部署多个专业怀疑论者角色，每个角色通过特定分析视角进行并行辩论树论证，并通过Panel Review机制从五个视角重新评估并纠正类别漂移和严重性校准。
AI.result: 在ToC-Bench（含414篇论文、1905个未陈述限制）上，ToC相比最强基线，精确率提升79%，覆盖率提升11%，生成的关注点具体且有证据支持。
AI.conclusion: Tree-of-Concerns能有效支持审稿人系统评估，帮助发现论文中未明确指出的潜在问题。

title: Structure for Reading, Prose for Writing: Asymmetric Structural Conditioning in Multi-Agent Document Authoring
summary: Multi-agent pipelines that author formal documents must both read a requester's forms and write against them. We report a deployed tender-response system, running an open-weights model under sovereignty constraints, and evaluate it against human-written bids the same organisation actually submitted. On a blind comparison where the system had no worked example available, an LLM judge rated its answers at least as good as the human-submitted answer on $40$ of $55$ ground-truth sections, better on $4$, missing on none, and flagged one unsupported claim in total. Classifying every gap the judge identified shows that $68\%$ were content absent from the system's own sources -- knowledge the human author held and the pipeline was never given -- so only $6$ of the $15$ adverse verdicts involve a deficiency the system could have avoided. A divergence from ground truth is more often an information-availability result than a writing-quality one, and evaluations that do not separate the two understate such systems. Against this backdrop we report a conditioning asymmetry. It is well established that rendering documents as structural markup rather than flat prose improves extraction, and we reproduce that on three reading tasks. The benefit does not transfer to conditioning: converting a bid's \emph{instruction} material from prose to nested XML dropped answer quality from $74\%$ to $48\%$ under a paired comparison. We further find that naming a forbidden construction concentrates rather than removes it -- $96\%$ of surviving defects fall in the two forms the prompt explicitly names -- and that coupling a stochastic annotation to a deterministic windowing function moves the extracted requirement count from $68$ to $51$ on a byte-identical file. Structure belongs where the model reads; prose and self-applied tests belong where it writes.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个在主权约束下运行的投标响应系统，并评估其与人工撰写的投标文件的性能。结果表明，系统在多数情况下与人工相当或更好，且大多数差距源于信息缺失而非写作质量。研究还发现，将指令材料从散文转换为XML会降低生成质量，命名禁止结构反而增加其出现频率，随机注释与确定性窗口函数的耦合会降低需求提取数量。
AI.motivation: 多智能体管道在撰写正式文档时需要同时读取请求表格并据此撰写，但目前缺乏对这类系统在真实部署环境下的系统评估，特别是与人工撰写的对比。此外，文档结构对读取和生成的影响存在不对称性，需要进一步探究。
AI.method: 部署了一个使用开放权重模型、在主权约束下运行的投标响应系统，并对其输出与同一组织实际提交的人工投标文件进行了盲评。使用LLM法官进行评估，并对差距进行分类。同时进行了多项对照实验，分别测试结构标记对提取和条件生成的影响、禁止命名结构的效果，以及随机注释与确定窗口函数耦合的影响。
AI.result: 在55个真实投标部分中，系统在40个上至少与人工相当，4个更好，未遗漏任何部分，仅发现1个无支持声明。68%的差距源于源信息缺失，只有6个负面裁决是系统本可避免的。结构标记提升提取效果，但将指令从散文转为XML使生成质量从74%降至48%。命名禁止结构导致96%的缺陷集中在这两类上。耦合随机注释与确定窗口函数使提取数量从68降至51。
AI.conclusion: 结构适合模型读取，而散文和自测适合模型生成。信息可用性比写作质量更能解释与真实答案的差异，评估应区分这两种因素，以准确反映此类系统的真实能力。

title: OccluRank: Controllable Occlusion-Aware Layout-to-Image Generation by Adding Just an Ordinal Rank
summary: Layout-to-image generation enables explicit spatial control through bounding-box layouts, yet bounding boxes specify only instance locations and cannot represent their occlusion order. Existing methods may rely on additional geometric conditions, employ complex inference procedures, or aggregate independently constructed instance representations without explicitly modeling their occlusion-dependent interactions. We propose OccluRank, a simple and controllable occlusion-aware layout-to-image framework that augments each bounding box with only one ordinal rank. OccluRank encodes the user-specified occlusion order through lightweight rank-based conditioning and introduces an Order-aware Instance Interaction (OII) module to jointly update rank-conditioned instance representations before aggregation. This allows the specified order to guide information exchange among occluding instances without additional geometric inputs or specialized inference-time optimization. We further construct OccluLayout, a synthetic training dataset whose occlusion order and amodal annotations are derived directly from known scene geometry rather than estimated from partially occluded images using auxiliary prediction models. For comprehensive evaluation, we introduce OccluLayout-Bench, which uses multiple multimodal large language model evaluators to assess instance presence, spatial layout, attributes, and occlusion order, together with FID for overall image quality. Experiments show that OccluRank more reliably preserves target instances, follows specified layouts, and realizes desired occlusion relationships while maintaining comparable attribute consistency and overall image quality.

AI.tldr: 提出OccluRank，通过为每个边界框添加一个顺序秩来显式建模遮挡关系，并引入顺序感知的实例交互模块，实现可控的遮挡感知布局到图像生成。
AI.motivation: 现有布局到图像生成方法仅使用边界框无法表示遮挡顺序，而现有处理遮挡的方法要么需要额外几何条件，要么推理复杂，要么未显式建模遮挡依赖的交互。
AI.method: OccluRank为每个边界框增加一个顺序秩，通过轻量级秩条件编码，并设计顺序感知实例交互（OII）模块，在聚合前联合更新秩条件的实例表示，以引导信息交换。同时构建合成数据集OccluLayout，利用场景几何直接获取遮挡顺序和amodal标注，并引入OccluLayout-Bench评估框架。
AI.result: 实验表明OccluRank在保留目标实例、遵循布局和实现遮挡关系方面更可靠，同时保持属性一致性和整体图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 仅添加顺序秩并采用顺序感知交互即可有效实现遮挡感知的布局到图像生成，无需额外几何输入或推理优化。

title: Knowing but Not Saying: Preventing Factual Access Failures in LLM SFT via Recall-Anchored Distillation
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can degrade factual behavior outside the target domain. This degradation is often described as catastrophic forgetting, yet open-ended factual failures do not necessarily imply that the underlying facts have been erased. In this work, we identify a more specific phenomenon, factual access failure: after domain SFT, models can still recognize or rank the correct answer under constrained evaluation, while failing to produce it in closed-book generation. Through benchmark-level comparisons, same-fact multiple-choice and generation probes, and failure-mode analysis, we show that SFT-induced factual degradation reflects both genuine wrong-answer generations and expression-level failures such as verbosity, formatting mismatch, and exact-match artifacts. To address this problem, we introduce Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD), a base-anchored self-distillation objective that preserves out-of-distribution generation behavior by aligning the adapted model with the original base model's soft continuation distribution on unlabeled OOD text. RAD requires no gold OOD answers, external judges, or labeled factual data. Across three backbones fine-tuned on MedMCQA, RAD recovers a consistent portion of the lost OOD recall while preserving target-domain adaptation. Compared with replay on the same OOD text, RAD shows that the key preservation signal is the base model's soft distribution rather than additional text exposure alone.

AI.tldr: 本文发现领域SFT导致的OOD事实退化主要是“事实访问失败”（模型在受限评估中仍能识别正确答案，但在闭卷生成中失败），并提出基于基座模型的自蒸馏方法RAD，通过对齐基座模型的软分布来保留OOD生成行为，无需额外标注数据。
AI.motivation: SFT在目标领域外会降低事实性表现，以往归因于灾难性遗忘，但作者认为这并非事实被擦除，而是访问失败。现有方法未区分错误生成与表达层面问题（如措辞、格式），且依赖额外数据或外部评判，需要更有效的保留策略。
AI.method: 提出Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD)，使用基座模型在无标签OOD文本上的软续接分布作为锚点，采用自蒸馏目标函数，使适应后的模型在OOD生成行为上对齐基座模型，无需gold答案或外部评判。RAD与回放方法对比，验证软分布是保留信号的关键。
AI.result: 在三个基座模型上使用MedMCQA进行SFT后，RAD显著恢复了OOD的召回率（部分恢复），同时保持了目标领域的适应性能。与回放相同OOD文本相比，RAD显示软分布比单纯文本暴露更有效。
AI.conclusion: SFT导致的OOD事实退化主要是访问失败而非知识擦除；RAD通过基座模型软分布锚定，能有效缓解此问题，为领域适应中的知识保留提供了新思路。

title: Dynamic Context Scheduling: Learning Beyond the Static Universe
summary: We study dynamic context scheduling as a training instrument for contextual re- inforcement learning. Rather than treating intra-episode context variation as a deployment reality, we treat it as a controlled shaping mechanism. Thereby, context evolves within each training episode according to a predetermined schedule, expos- ing the policy to a richer and more temporally structured region of the environment parameter space. We introduce DYNAMICCARLENV, a framework that wraps contextual environments with pluggable schedule families, such as sinusoidal off- sets or cosine annealing. Across CartPole, BipedalWalker and VehicleRacing with CARL contextualization, we show that dynamic schedules match or outperform static context baselines in the out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes. Interestingly, for the more complex BipedalWalker and VehicleRacing environments we also achieve higher in-distribution (ID) evaluation performance. Preliminary findings indicate that automatic search for multi-stage curricula can successfully discover schedules that improve generalization, performing comparably to extensive grid search over single-stage schedulers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态上下文调度作为上下文强化学习的训练工具，通过在训练过程中按预定义方式改变上下文，提升策略在分布外和分布内场景的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文强化学习常将训练时的上下文视为固定或随机变化，但动态、结构化的上下文变化可能更有利于学习鲁棒策略。
AI.method: 提出DYNAMICCARLENV框架，支持正弦偏移、余弦退火等多种调度族，以控制训练过程中上下文的演变。
AI.result: 在CartPole、BipedalWalker和VehicleRacing环境中，动态调度在分布外（OOD）性能上匹配或超过静态基线，并在复杂环境中提升分布内（ID）性能。自动搜索多阶段课程可媲美网格搜索单阶段调度。
AI.conclusion: 动态上下文调度是一种有效的训练工具，能改善上下文强化学习的泛化能力，尤其在复杂环境中表现更佳。

title: LHMCF-Net: A Learned Hyperbolic Mean Curvature Flow Network for Medical Images Segmentation
summary: Motivated by the classical Chan-Vese model and the ability of deep priors to capture complex spatial structures, we develop a segmentation model that leverages learned hyperbolic mean curvature flow (LHMCF) as a mathematical foundation for integrating feature space data fidelity and deep structural priors within a unified high-dimensional framework. The proposed LHMCF model is governed by a second-order dissipative hyperbolic PDE, where the introduction of a velocity field provides inertia and momentum to the evolving interface. This hyperbolic mechanism enables the contour to bypass noise-induced local minima and propagate coherently through low-contrast or ambiguous regions, addressing limitations inherent to first-order parabolic flows. To solve the continuous LHMCF model, we construct a deep unfolding network, named LHMCF-Net, which maps the iterative numerical procedure of the PDE into a sequence of discrete evolution stages. Each stage corresponds to one physically interpretable update of the underlying dynamical system, allowing the network to inherit the stability and geometric consistency of the PDE while supporting end-to-end optimization. Comprehensive experiments on three publicly available medical segmentation datasets demonstrate that LHMCF-Net achieves superior performance, particularly in challenging scenarios with low contrast and unclear boundaries. These results highlight the effectiveness of embedding hyperbolic geometric evolution into deep unfolding architectures and underscore the potential of physically inspired models for robust medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于学习型双曲平均曲率流（LHMCF）的医学图像分割模型，通过引入速度场提供惯性和动量，克服了传统一阶抛物线流的局限，并构建了对应的深度展开网络LHMCF-Net，在低对比度和模糊边界场景下取得了优越性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的Chan-Vese模型和基于一阶抛物线流的深度分割方法在处理低对比度、噪声干扰和边界模糊的医学图像时容易陷入局部极小值，且缺乏对复杂空间结构的有效捕捉能力。
AI.method: 提出了由二阶耗散双曲型偏微分方程控制的LHMCF模型，引入速度场提供惯性和动量；设计了深度展开网络LHMCF-Net，将PDE的迭代数值过程映射为离散演化阶段，每个阶段对应一个物理可解释的更新，支持端到端优化。
AI.result: 在三个公开医学分割数据集上的综合实验表明，LHMCF-Net在低对比度和模糊边界等挑战性场景中取得了优于现有方法的分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 将双曲几何演化嵌入深度展开架构能有效提升医学图像分割的鲁棒性，展示了物理启发模型在医学图像分析中的潜力。

title: Denoising the Future: Context-Aware Spectral Diffusion for Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) extrapolation seeks to infer future facts from time-varying relational histories. Recent diffusion-based approaches improve uncertainty modeling through generative denoising, but their aggregated conditioning on subject histories may insufficiently distinguish query-specific evidence from non-salient historical facts, thereby diluting target-discriminative signals. To bridge this gap, we propose FreqDiff, a Frequency-aware Diffusion framework for TKG extrapolation. Specifically, FreqDiff formulates future object prediction as query-slot denoising and develops a dual-stream denoiser that integrates temporal dependency modeling with context-aware spectral calibration. The spectral branch synthesizes history-conditioned filters from learnable bases to adaptively re-calibrate denoising representations, while a frequency-domain regularizer is proposed to align the denoised target with the gold object in spectral space. Experiments on four public TKG benchmarks demonstrate that FreqDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种频率感知扩散框架FreqDiff，通过双流去噪器和频谱校准提升时序知识图谱外推的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的方法在时序知识图谱外推中对主题历史的聚合条件化处理，可能无法充分区分查询特定证据与非显著历史事实，从而稀释目标判别信号。
AI.method: 将未来对象预测建模为查询槽去噪，设计双流去噪器，结合时间依赖建模与上下文感知频谱校准；频谱分支从可学习基合成历史条件滤波器，自适应重新校准去噪表示；并提出频域正则化，将去噪目标与真实对象在频谱空间对齐。
AI.result: 在四个公共TKG基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: FreqDiff通过频率感知的扩散框架有效提升了时序知识图谱外推的准确性。

title: SPARC: Single-Pass Scaling for Motion Forecasting with Conformal Bayesian Last Layers
summary: Human motion forecasters are increasingly accurate and fast, but reliable deployment requires uncertainty estimates that are structured, calibrated, and efficient. Bayesian and ensemble-based uncertainty estimates often require repeated stochastic inference [15, 26], while conformal calibration alone does not provide an epistemic signal or preserve trajectory covariance structure [14, 50]. We introduce SPARC (Single-Pass Adaptive Risk Calibration), a Bayesian-conformal uncertainty layer for motion forecasting. A deterministic MLP backbone predicts the future mean, and a conjugate Bayesian last layer converts time-domain feature leverage into an analytic horizon-wise epistemic scale $κ_t(x)$. This scale inflates a graph-temporal Gaussian covariance without changing its correlation structure, and split conformal calibration produces 95% marginal prediction tubes with finite-sample validity under exchangeability. The key interface is the structured factorization $κ_t(x)Σ_{\mathrm{str},t}(x)$, which injects feature-space epistemic uncertainty into trajectory densities without Monte Carlo sampling. Across nine dataset-protocol blocks and deterministic, multimodal, and calibration baselines, SPARC ranks first on NLL and on the combined MPJPE+NLL criterion while retaining competitive point accuracy and efficient calibrated tubes. Ranking windows by $κ$ separates high-error cases, making the scale usable as a lightweight risk monitor.

AI.tldr: SPARC是一种用于运动预测的贝叶斯-共形不确定性层，通过单次前向传播提供结构化、校准且高效的不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性估计方法要么需要重复随机推理（如贝叶斯方法），要么缺乏认知信号或破坏轨迹协方差结构（如共形校准）。
AI.method: 使用确定性MLP预测未来均值，贝叶斯最后一层输出解析的认知尺度κ，并将其与图-时间高斯协方差结合，最后通过分裂共形校准生成95%预测区间。
AI.result: 在9个数据集-协议块上，SPARC在NLL和MPJPE+NLL联合指标上排名第一，同时保持竞争性的点精度和高效的校准区间。
AI.conclusion: SPARC提供了一种无需蒙特卡洛采样的轻量级认知不确定性信号，可用于风险监测，且不牺牲预测精度。

title: SuppreSensing: Expert-Guided Feature Recalibration and Discrepancy Augmentation for Multimodal Object Detection
summary: Multimodal object detection in remote sensing faces challenges due to semantic heterogeneity and modality-specific noise interference. To this end, we propose SuppreSensing, which reformulates multimodal fusion as a selective collaboration process that jointly models shared information and modality-specific cues. SuppreSensing first designs an Expert-driven Multimodal Feature Recalibration (EMFR) module, which reformulates shared-consensus extraction as an input-adaptive multi-expert selection process to alleviate the symmetry trap in multimodal fusion. Complementing this, a modality-specific attribute augmentation strategy is employed to enhance specific modality features by modeling bidirectional discrepancy patterns, mitigating cross-modal heterogeneity. Furthermore, we propose an Expert-driven Customized Feature Purification (ECFP) module based on a "specialized inspection-comprehensive analysis-diagnostic update" physical examination paradigm to iteratively filter redundancies and reinforce task-relevant semantics. Extensive experiments on the DroneVehicle and VEDAI datasets demonstrate that SuppreSensing achieves state-of-the-art detection performance. Cross-domain evaluations on natural scene datasets (FLIR and LLVIP) further validate its superior robustness and generalization capability across diverse environmental conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SuppreSensing，一种用于遥感多模态目标检测的新型融合方法，通过选择性协作建模共享与特有信息，在多个数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态遥感目标检测面临语义异质性和模态特定噪声干扰的挑战，现有融合方法常陷入对称性陷阱，未能有效区分共享与特有信息。
AI.method: 方法包括专家驱动的多模态特征重标定（EMFR）模块，将共享共识提取转化为输入自适应多专家选择；模态特定属性增强策略，通过双向差异模式增强特有特征；以及专家驱动的定制特征纯化（ECFP）模块，采用“专项检查-综合分析-诊断更新”的体检范式迭代过滤冗余并强化任务相关语义。
AI.result: 在DroneVehicle和VEDAI数据集上达到最先进检测性能，在自然场景数据集FLIR和LLVIP上的跨域评估验证了强鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SuppreSensing有效缓解了多模态融合中的语义异质性和噪声干扰问题，其创新性模块设计显著提升了检测精度和跨域适应能力。

title: STAR-OPD: Structured Aspect-Cascade-Aware On-Policy Reward Distillation for ABSA Quadruple Extraction
summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) quadruple extraction requires jointly predicting target, aspect, opinion, and sentiment over reviews that often contain multiple fine-grained sentiment tuples. While large chain-of-thought (CoT) models perform well on this task, distilling them into smaller deployable models remains difficult. We identify a task-specific failure mode in distilled ABSA extraction: student errors at the target-aspect interface create structurally invalid states, such as broken target-aspect bindings and hallucinated targets, which then corrupt downstream predictions. Conventional off-policy distillation is poorly suited to this setting because it trains only on teacher-generated trajectories and provides little supervision on the student-induced structural states that dominate inference. To address this mismatch, we propose STAR-OPD (STructured Aspect-cascade-aware On-Policy Reward Distillation), which builds on generic on-policy distillation and instantiates it for ABSA quadruple extraction with cascade-aware, set-structured rewards. STAR-OPD trains on student rollouts and applies set-structured rewards that directly target binding consistency, target grounding, and fine-grained aspect disambiguation. Experiments on E-ABSA20K and SemEval-2014 show that STAR-OPD consistently outperforms off-policy and general on-policy baselines, reduces target hallucination, and substantially improves performance on structurally hard cases. With Qwen3-4B, STAR-OPD substantially narrows the student-teacher gap while improving inference efficiency, highlighting the importance of on-policy structural correction for distilled ABSA extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAR-OPD，一种针对ABSA四元组抽取的蒸馏方法，通过结构化级联感知的on-policy奖励，有效解决学生模型在目标-方面接口上的结构错误，提升性能并缩小与教师的差距。
AI.motivation: 大型CoT模型在ABSA四元组抽取上表现优异，但蒸馏到小型模型困难；传统off-policy蒸馏在蒸馏ABSA时存在任务特定的失败模式，即学生在目标-方面接口产生结构无效状态，而off-policy训练无法有效纠正这些状态。
AI.method: 提出STAR-OPD，基于通用on-policy蒸馏，并针对ABSA四元组抽取实例化，采用级联感知的集合结构化奖励，直接监督绑定一致性、目标接地和细粒度方面消歧。
AI.result: 在E-ABSA20K和SemEval-2014上，STAR-OPD一致优于off-policy和通用on-policy基线，减少目标幻觉，显著改善结构困难案例；使用Qwen3-4B时大幅缩小师生差距并提高推理效率。
AI.conclusion: STAR-OPD验证了on-policy结构校正对蒸馏ABSA抽取的重要性，为复杂结构化任务的蒸馏提供了新方向。

title: SAC-Copula: Quality-Preserving Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Smooth Correlated Gumbel Fields
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 13 figures
summary: Watermarking diffusion language models (DLMs) requires mechanisms compatible with iterative parallel unmasking rather than autoregressive decoding. Existing sampling-based watermarking methods typically inject position-wise i.i.d. perturbations, which can be poorly aligned with DLM decoding dynamics and degrade generation quality. We propose SAC-Copula, a quality-preserving watermarking method for DLMs based on smooth, locally correlated Gumbel perturbation fields constructed via a Gaussian copula. We further develop a SAC-aware detector using covariance-aware filtering and native-sample calibration. Mechanism-level analysis shows that local correlation reduces latent perturbation roughness and better matches iterative refinement dynamics. Experiments on LLaDA show that SAC-Copula achieves a favorable quality-detectability trade-off compared with existing baselines. In particular, further evaluations on Dream-7B and additional datasets show that SAC-Copula substantially improves PPL tail stability over the i.i.d. Gumbel baseline, while maintaining strong low-FPR detectability and competitive overall generation quality. Additional token-edit stress tests further assess watermark robustness under controlled synchronization drift.

AI.tldr: 提出SAC-Copula，一种基于高斯copula的平滑局部相关Gumbel扰动场的水印方法，用于扩散语言模型，在保持生成质量的同时实现强可检测性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于采样的水印方法通常注入逐位置独立同分布扰动，与DLM的迭代并行解掩码动态不对齐，导致生成质量下降。
AI.method: 使用高斯copula构建平滑局部相关的Gumbel扰动场，并开发SAC-aware检测器，采用协方差感知滤波和原生样本校准。
AI.result: 在LLaDA上达到质量-可检测性权衡优势；在Dream-7B及额外数据集上显著提高PPL尾部稳定性，同时保持低假阳性率可检测性和竞争力生成质量；token编辑压力测试评估了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SAC-Copula通过局部相关性减少潜在扰动粗糙度，更好匹配迭代细化动态，实现质量保持的水印，优于i.i.d.基线。

title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreak attacks that progressively manipulate conversation context. Existing certified robustness methods are limited to single-turn inputs; naive multi-turn composition yields bounds that degrade exponentially in the number of turns. We introduce Multi-Turn Certified Robustness (MTCR), a framework that models conversational safety via State-Adversarial MDPs and defines $k$-turn certified robustness as the worst-case safety probability across $k$ adversarial turns. MTCR comprises: (i) compositional certification via embedding-space mode decomposition, yielding tighter certified lower bounds than naive multiplication; (ii) $(α,β)$-safety persistence, improving the degradation rate from $\underline{p}^{k}$ to $β^k$ (with $β> \underline{p}$) and yielding interpretable horizon estimates; (iii) matching information-theoretic upper bounds establishing tightness; and (iv) a unified algorithm combining these results. Experiments on six LLMs under $ε$-bounded and Crescendo-style attacks confirm that empirical safety consistently exceeds the certified bounds.

AI.tldr: 提出多轮认证鲁棒性框架MTCR，通过状态对抗MDP建模对话安全，实现更紧的认证下界和更优的安全退化率，实验验证理论有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有认证鲁棒性方法仅针对单轮输入，朴素的多轮组合导致安全边界随轮数指数衰减，无法应对多轮越狱攻击。
AI.method: 构建状态对抗MDP定义k轮认证鲁棒性；使用嵌入空间模式分解进行组合认证；提出(α,β)-安全持续性改善退化率；结合信息论上界证明紧性；设计统一算法。
AI.result: 在6种LLM上，ε-有界和Crescendo风格攻击下的经验安全性始终超过认证下界，验证方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: MTCR为多轮对话提供了首个可认证的安全保证，显著优于朴素组合方法，并为多轮安全表征提供新思路。

title: Kinematic Knowledge Maps for Pattern Alignment: Structured Latent Representational Learning in Multimodal Gait Analysis
summary: Multimodal clinical AI is limited by weakly aligned inputs and the absence of domain-specific interpretable representations, particularly when learning from dense video stream, structured time-series, and template-based kinematic text. Here we present ScoliDetect, an explainable framework for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis screening from monocular gait video, built around a kinematic knowledge map (KKM) and complementary template-based kinematic text derived from per-sequence pose statics. KKM is a fixed-index structured representation that encodes gait features across absolute motion, self-skeleton configuration and joint-joint signal correlation, providing anchor-referenced multimodal fusion and factor-level interpretation. We integrate video, KKM, and template-based kinematic text through bidirectional cross-attention with latent-bottleneck aggregation. In a multicenter cohort (n = 1,858 after exclusions), prespecified supervised ablations on an external screening cohort show that KKM-mediated multimodal fusion outperforms unimodal models and late concatenation. Under a staged training protocol, trimodal contrastive pretraining is applied after architecture selection as representation initialization, improving external ROC-AUC from 0.961 to 0.972. Furthermore, the structured nature of the KKM provides inherent, factor-level attributions mapped directly to specific kinematic phases and skeletal indices, offering verifiable interpretability. The results demonstrate that embedding explicit structural topologies into latent spaces significantly enhances both the generalization and explainability of multimodal pattern analysis systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScoliDetect，一个基于单目步态视频的青少年特发性脊柱侧凸可解释筛查框架，通过运动学知识图谱（KKM）和模板化运动学文本实现多模态融合，在外部验证中AUC从0.961提升至0.972，并提供因子级可解释性。
AI.motivation: 多模态临床AI受限于弱对齐输入和缺乏领域特定的可解释表示，尤其是在处理密集视频流、结构化时间序列和模板化运动学文本时，导致模型泛化性和可解释性不足。
AI.method: 构建KKM（固定索引结构）编码步态特征（绝对运动、骨骼构型、关节间相关性），结合视频、KKM和模板化运动学文本，通过双向交叉注意力+潜在瓶颈聚合进行融合；采用分阶段训练，先架构选择后进行三模态对比预训练。
AI.result: 在外部筛查队列中，KKM介导的多模态融合优于单模态和晚期拼接；对比预训练使外部ROC-AUC从0.961提升至0.972；KKM提供因子级归因，可直接映射到运动学阶段和骨骼指标。
AI.conclusion: 将显式结构拓扑嵌入潜在空间可显著提升多模态模式分析系统的泛化性和可解释性，ScoliDetect验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Neuro-Geospatial Modelling of EEG Affective States Using Literature-Informed Environmental Context
summary: Environmental exposures such as air pollution and greenness have been associated with affective and cognitive outcomes, but EEG and environmental datasets are rarely jointly georeferenced. We investigate whether literature-informed environmental priors can serve as an auxiliary geospatial modality for EEG-based affective-state classification when individual-level exposure data are unavailable. We combine 30-channel EEG from the EAV benchmark (42 participants, aged 20-30 years) with environmental representations derived from OpenAQ, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-5P, and OpenStreetMap data for Astana. A dual-tower architecture combines EEG-Conformer representations with a graph-based environmental encoder. Because the datasets are not co-registered, environmental context is treated as a literature-informed prior rather than measured exposure. Subject-level repeated splits, permutation and label-shuffling controls, dose-response reversal, and domain-shift experiments distinguish architecture-level gains from prior-dependent gains. The multimodal model achieves 76.2% accuracy versus 67.4% for EEG alone. Controls disrupting environmental-label structure retain part of this gain, indicating that the improvement is not attributable solely to environmental information. Replacing the Astana environmental distribution with an independently modeled Singapore distribution reduces accuracy to 72.8%. These findings demonstrate technical feasibility but do not establish an observed or causal exposure-affect association. The study provides a framework for future jointly collected mobile EEG-environment studies. Implementation: https://github.com/r11up/geo-cog

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在缺乏个体暴露数据时，将文献支持的环境先验作为辅助地理空间模态，用于基于EEG的情感状态分类。双塔架构结合EEG和环境影响，准确率达76.2%，优于仅用EEG的67.4%，但控制实验表明提升不完全归因于环境信息。
AI.motivation: 环境暴露（如空气污染和绿地）与情感和认知结果相关，但EEG与环境数据集很少联合地理参考。作者希望探索在无法获取个体暴露数据时，环境先验能否作为辅助模态提升EEG情感分类性能。
AI.method: 使用EAV基准的30通道EEG数据（42名参与者）和Astana地区的环境数据（OpenAQ、Sentinel-2、Sentinel-5P、OpenStreetMap）。采用双塔架构：EEG-Conformer提取EEG特征，图基环境编码器处理环境数据。通过多种控制实验（如置换、标签洗牌、剂量-反应反转、域转移）区分架构增益和环境依赖增益。
AI.result: 多模态模型准确率76.2%，高于EEG单独的67.4%。破坏环境标签结构的控制实验保留了部分增益，表明提升不完全来自环境信息。将环境分布替换为新加坡分布时，准确率降至72.8%。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了技术可行性，但未建立观察或因果暴露-情感关联。为未来联合收集的移动EEG-环境研究提供了框架。

title: WA-JEPA: Rethinking the Video JEPA Paradigm for World-Action Modeling in Autonomous Driving
summary: Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) learns powerful spatiotemporal representations from video through self-supervised latent feature prediction. However, V-JEPA is built around random-mask completion and deterministic regression, making it fundamentally ill-suited for autonomous driving planning that demands future-directed prediction tightly coupled with action. To address this, we rethink the V-JEPA paradigm and present WA-JEPA, a V-JEPA-native world-action model designed for autonomous driving planning. Instead of random spatiotemporal masking, WA-JEPA employs hybrid future-masked pre-training, where the model infers future latents from observed context. Departing from deterministic regression, we recast future prediction as conditional flow matching over latent futures, which substantially improves the model's ability to generate plausible future latents for downstream planning. Finally, a joint future-action predictor is proposed to denoise future scene tokens and ego trajectories together in a unified spatiotemporal latent space, allowing action supervision to directly shape planning-relevant world representations. Pre-trained on nuPlan videos and fine-tuned on NAVSIM, WA-JEPA reaches 91.7 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v2, surpassing the strongest end-to-end and world-action baselines by 1.6 and 1.3 EPDMS, and, without HUGSIM-specific fine-tuning, attains the best HD-Score of 0.4462 on the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark under the same evaluation protocol. These results validate V-JEPA-native world-action modeling as a powerful and scalable paradigm for autonomous driving planning. Code is available at https://github.com/AFARI-Research/WA-JEPA.

AI.tldr: 提出WA-JEPA，一种基于V-JEPA范式的世界-动作模型，通过混合未来掩码预训练和条件流匹配，实现自动驾驶规划，在NAVSIM和HUGSIM基准上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: V-JEPA虽能学习强大的时空表征，但其随机掩码和确定性回归不适合自动驾驶规划，缺乏对未来预测与动作的紧密耦合。
AI.method: 采用混合未来掩码预训练（推断未来潜在特征），将未来预测重新表述为潜在空间上的条件流匹配，并设计联合未来-动作预测器，在统一时空潜在空间中联合去噪未来场景令牌和自车轨迹。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM-v2上达到91.7 EPDMS，超过最强基线1.6和1.3 EPDMS；在HUGSIM上取得最佳HD-Score 0.4462，无需特定微调。
AI.conclusion: V-JEPA原生世界-动作建模是自动驾驶规划的强大且可扩展范式。

title: Prediction certification cannot replace explanation certification: a competence envelope for trustworthy AI under compound stress
summary: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly make consequential judgments - which patient is deteriorating, which building is safe to enter, whether an image is authentic and are trusted on the strength of how accurately and confidently they predict. The safeguards that certify them are correspondingly prediction-based: accuracy, calibration and conformal coverage all measure how well a model performs. Whether such checks are sufficient to establish model trustworthiness has remained unclear. Here we prove that they cannot. We establish a separation theorem showing that a reliable model and a compromised one can be identical under every prediction-side certificate, including accuracy, calibration and coverage, yet differ arbitrarily in explanation fidelity and deployment behaviour. Detecting this failure requires access to the model's decision mechanism in addition to its predictions. We introduce the competence envelope as an operational framework that combines prediction and explanation certification into a single deployable criterion. Across diverse datasets and model classes, the proposed framework reveals failure modes that prediction-side certification alone does not capture. Certification against failures that are invisible in prediction behaviour therefore requires evidence about the model's decision mechanism as well as its outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文证明仅基于预测的认证（如准确性、校准和覆盖范围）无法确保模型的可信度，并提出了结合预测与解释认证的“能力包络”框架，以检测预测行为中不可见的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在关键决策中的广泛应用，其信任度主要依赖于预测准确性等指标，但这些指标是否足以证明模型的可信度尚未明确。
AI.method: 通过建立分离定理，证明可靠模型和受损模型在预测侧认证下可能完全相同，但解释保真度和部署行为不同；引入“能力包络”框架，结合预测和解释认证，并在多种数据集和模型上测试。
AI.result: 能力包络框架揭示了仅靠预测侧认证无法捕获的失败模式，证明需要访问模型决策机制才能检测此类失败。
AI.conclusion: 确保模型可信度需要同时认证预测输出和决策机制，仅依赖预测行为认证不足以保证模型安全。

title: MigrationNarrate: A Dataset for Detection of Migration Narratives in YouTube Videos
comment: This work was accepted to the main conference of EMNLP 2026
summary: Narratives are central to how social communication is framed, making their detection critical for understanding and analysing public discourse. Prior work has explored narrative detection and extraction across diverse domains; however, migration narratives remain significantly understudied, primarily due to the absence of dedicated annotated datasets. Furthermore, public communication has recently shifted towards video-centric platforms, where narratives are conveyed through multimodal signals and consumed at scale. Despite this shift, narratives in videos remain largely unexplored. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MigrationNarrate, the first multimodal dataset for detection of migration narratives in the UK, consisting of 1,115 YouTube video transcripts annotated using a two-level taxonomy of 12 migration super-narratives and 53 narrative labels. This paper details the dataset design, collection, and annotations; together with benchmark results using a combination of pre-trained encoder models and both open- and closed-source Large Language Models. Finally, a thorough error analysis offers insights for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首个用于检测英国移民叙事的多模态数据集MigrationNarrate，包含1,115个YouTube视频转录本，采用两级分类体系（12个超级叙事和53个叙事标签），并提供了基准测试和错误分析。
AI.motivation: 现有叙事检测研究忽视了移民领域，缺乏相关标注数据集；同时，视频平台成为主流传播渠道，但视频中的叙事检测尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建了多模态数据集MigrationNarrate，设计了包含12个超级叙事和53个叙事标签的两级分类体系，并使用预训练编码器模型及开源/闭源大语言模型进行基准测试，最后进行了错误分析。
AI.result: 成功构建了数据集，并提供了基准测试结果，揭示了模型在移民叙事检测中的性能及常见错误类型。
AI.conclusion: MigrationNarrate填补了视频中移民叙事检测的空白，为未来研究提供了数据资源和基线，同时错误分析指出了改进方向。
